svg.text: SHOP BLUEPRINT — CUT LIST & ANGLE REFERENCE
Hexagonal Pavilion | Saanich, BC | BCBC 2018 | Date: 2026-04-19
All dimensions in INCHES unless noted. Rough sawn cedar throughout. Verify all dimensions before cutting.
Finial or rain cap on top
Add 15% waste to all BF totals when placing lumber order.
ANGLE REFERENCE QUICK CARD — FOR SAW SETUP
Do NOT flip bevel — all 6 cuts identical
Rafter tail (beam end): plumb cut only at 18.43°
Bird's mouth seat depth: 1-1/2" (do not exceed)
*** Test on scrap 4x6 before cutting production ***
SDS lags: 2 per rafter, pre-drill 1/4" pilot into hub
Rafter-to-beam: Simpson H2.5A hurricane tie + bird's mouth
Horizontal run: 72" total (60" to hub + 12" overhang)
Rise to hub: 20" | Total rafter length: 76" (6'-4")
Hex exterior angle = 60°; miter saw set to 30°
Dry-fit all 6 beams before hardware installation
Both ends: 45° plumb cut only (no bevel)
Bolts: (2) 1/2" x 5" carriage bolts each end
25 MPa concrete. J-bolt set wet. ABA66Z base.

g.text: ZMAX galvanized adjustable standoff post base
Black powder coat, post cap for 6x6 post / 6x8 beam
3/8" thick, laser cut to template per joinery-spec.json
+ 2" sq plate washer + nut — ASTM A307 galvanized
+ 2" sq plate washer + nut — galvanized hex head
Simpson SDS25600 or equal hex-head structural lag
Box of 100 — supplemental connections and hub lamination

svg.text: GENERAL NOTES FOR SHOP AND SITE
1. Mark all lumber crown-side before cutting. Orient crowns up on rafters and beams.
2. Pre-drill all bolt holes. Avoid splitting ends: maintain 1-3/4" minimum edge distance on all bolts.
3. All exterior hardware to be hot-dip galvanized (ASTM A153) or stainless. No electro-galv in direct contact with cedar.
4. Apply oil-based end-grain sealer (Anchorseal or equal) to all fresh cuts within 24 hours of cutting.
5. Verify all 6 footing locations with laser level and string lines before pouring concrete. Check all diagonals equal (8'-8" approx).
6. Install hub as last structural element. Dry-fit all 6 rafters before driving SDS screws. Adjust hub height on temporary post if needed.
7. This is a no-permit structure per Saanich BCBC 2018 exemption threshold. Builder verifies final jurisdiction requirements before starting.
